sections.heading: The modern way to reduce PDF size.
body: Traditional PDF compression tools require uploading your sensitive contracts, marksheets, and financial statements to remote cloud servers. This exposes personal information to data breaches and server retention risks.

Zcompressor re-engineers PDF compression inside your web browser. By compiling compression algorithms directly into WebAssembly, your documents are reduced locally in seconds without sending a single byte across the internet.

faq.q: How much can I reduce my PDF file size?
faq.a: Depending on the initial document structure and scanned image resolution, Zcompressor typically reduces PDF file sizes by 50% to 90%.
